description: This Java class 'ShippingQuoteController' functions as a REST controller in a Spring Boot application. It handles HTTP requests related to shipping rate quotes, validates input, and delegates logic to the 'RateQuoteFlow'. The class manages API endpoints under '/api/shipping', specifically the '/quotes' POST endpoint for obtaining shipping quotes, and provides API documentation annotations.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteController
classes.description: REST controller providing shipping quote APIs, handling request validation, and delegating to business logic flow.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the flow and mapper dependencies.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to obtain shipping rate quotes based on the provided request.
